port_hint.closed: Check that your router forwards this port to this PC and that the PC firewall allows it.
port_hint.firewall: Windows Firewall is blocking incoming connections on this port. For the network you are connected to now (private or public), allow saba-core if the server is stopped, or the game server program if it is running, in Windows Firewall settings, then check again.
port_hint.router: The PC firewall allows this port. Forward this port to this PC in your router settings, then check again.
port_hint.cgnat: Your provider shares one public IP among many homes, so port forwarding cannot open it. Ask your provider for a public IP or use a VPN such as Tailscale.
port_hint.unknown: UDP ports of a running server and ports another program uses cannot be checked. Stop the server and check again.

reasons.rejected: The server did not accept the command
reasons.not_supported: This game does not support it
reasons.timeout: The server did not answer in time
reasons.backup_file_locked: The server is using a file ({{file}}), so the backup could not be made. Stop the server and try again
reasons.backup_failed: The backup could not be made
reasons.backup_unsupported: This game does not support backups
reasons.nothing_to_back_up: There is no world to back up yet
reasons.backup_limit: The remote backup limit is full. Delete old backups on the PC
reasons.backup_busy: Another backup or restore is in progress
reasons.server_running: The server is on. Stop it first
reasons.no_command_path: The server was started outside Saba-chan, so it cannot take commands
reasons.autosave_not_resumed: The backup was made, but the server’s autosave could not be turned back on. Restart the server
reasons.backup_save_rejected: The server refused the save command, so no backup was made. Stop the server and back up again
reasons.backup_save_unconfirmed: The server did not report that saving finished, so no backup was made. Try again shortly or stop the server and back up
reasons.snapshot_not_found: The game has no automatic backup
reasons.snapshot_not_deletable: Saba-chan cannot delete the game’s own automatic backups
